ios.step: Audit actual iOS native selection and licenses
ios.confirmed_defect: Single-pin SPM audit schema cannot describe the actual four selected remote packages.
ios.unverified_detail: Exact first refusal (multiple Package.resolved files versus multiple pins) is hidden by the generic safe handler.
fix_plan: Extend scripts/app_notification_audit.py and its tests to bind the actual application Package.resolved while inventorying nested resolved files, not silently ignoring them.

Audit each allowlisted selected ION checkout version/revision, manifest and licence plus Capacitor binary checks. Reject unknown identities/revisions, missing licences, extra unresolved binary targets and inconsistent nested resolution.

Add meaningful specimens for the exact four-pin graph, genuine nested Package.resolved files and unknown/changed dependency negative cases; preserve privacy-safe errors and all permission/closed-SDK checks.

android.step: Audit exact Android runtime and license inputs
android.confirmed_failure: Fail-closed generic audit refusal after roughly46 seconds; exact audit stage is not exposed.
android.unverified_hypothesis: Workflow builds debug artifacts only, but runtime_evidence reads selected release project JAR/AAR paths too; unbuilt release inputs may be the refusal.
fix_plan: First add fixed stage/error-class diagnostics without parser, filesystem, network or contributor payloads, or reproduce using actual resolved graph in an isolated local build.

If missing release project artifacts is confirmed, make inspection depend on those actual selected build outputs or build the unsigned release configuration; never substitute debug artifacts or weaken the release audit.
Keep every existing permission, dependency, licence, provenance and file-containment guard effective.

limits: Failed audit jobs skipped parent-feature comparison and strict artifact upload; no successful APP2B native acceptance is claimed.
No changes, reviews, approvals, merges, workflow reruns/dispatches, configuration changes, secret reads or production actions performed.
